provenance.source_title: How Much Money Did A Peasant Actually Make
provenance.source_title_zh: 一个农民实际上能赚多少钱

examples.psychological_goal: 用"真但最没用"的降格判断瞬间反转观众对权威数字的预期
examples.expression_mechanism: 先引权威口径再当场降格,把已知答案变成问题的起点
examples.example_text: This number is true. It's also the least useful number in this entire story
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句话降格权威数字,为"名义 vs 实际"的重构开路
examples.negative_instruction: 不得复制原句与数字口径;新题目的权威数字必须真实存在且可归属

examples.psychological_goal: 把抽象的名义与实际之差落成可视化的两堆硬币画面
examples.expression_mechanism: 第二人称具身场景 + 双堆对照意象,零寒暄直接入场
examples.example_text: in front of you on the table in the dim light of your own hut lie two piles of coins
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用具身场景加一个对照意象登记全片框架
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制场景细节与器物;新主题需找到目标受众真实熟悉的场景

examples.psychological_goal: 把刚给出的量级答案明示登记为延迟契约,挂住中段
examples.expression_mechanism: 直接嘱咐"记住这个数字,会回来",把答案挂成待兑现承诺
examples.example_text: Keep this number in mind. We'll get back to her before this is over.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习明示式延迟登记:告诉观众哪个数字会在后段回来
examples.negative_instruction: 不要开了延迟契约不兑现;登记的事实必须在中段callback

examples.psychological_goal: 用"纸面规则 vs 现实"的对照金句击穿制度叙事的表面
examples.expression_mechanism: 前句立规则能力,后句用一个不能完成的动作否掉它
examples.example_text: the law can freeze a number on a page. He cannot make a dead worker stand up again in the field
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"能做到 A / 做不到 B"的对照句式暴露制度与现实缺口
examples.negative_instruction: 不得照搬原句意象;对照的两半必须都可在新材料中核实

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个带紧张感的小动作场景揭示真实行情并点明违法
examples.expression_mechanism: 环顾四周的动作细节 + 悄然出价 + 短句定性违法
examples.example_text: looks around to see who else is watching, and quietly offers you three. This is illegal.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用场景动作铺垫后接短句定性,让揭示自带张力
examples.negative_instruction: 不要为了紧张感虚构动作细节;场景必须来自材料

examples.psychological_goal: 用心照不宣的默契让观众会心一笑,同时完成"不可举证"的机制说明
examples.expression_mechanism: 冷面陈述 + 重复句式,把潜规则说成日常
examples.example_text: You eat well this harvest. You also understand, without any explanation, why you eat so well.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用重复句式的冷幽默点破当事人与观众的共谋感
examples.negative_instruction: 不得为搞笑而搞笑;笑点必须同时承担机制解释功能

examples.psychological_goal: 用可复算的乘法汇总给出标题问题的名义答案
examples.expression_mechanism: 天数×日价的口算链 + 单位换算,让观众自己跟上
examples.example_text: 30 days of paid harvest season at 3p per day, a total of 90p, which is 7 shillings and 6p
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把总额拆成可复算的口算链,并顺手完成单位换算
examples.negative_instruction: 不得复制具体数字与币制;新材料的算术必须真实可复算

examples.psychological_goal: 在账面高点立刻预告流失,把满足感转成失血悬念
examples.expression_mechanism: "最后一次完全属于你"的预告句,高点即转折
examples.example_text: This is also the last moment in this whole story where this number is still completely yours.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在数字高点用一句预告把满足反转为悬念
examples.negative_instruction: 不要提前泄露扣减细节;预告只点方向不点内容

examples.psychological_goal: 用比例对比句把第一刀扣减放大成"大半已属于别人"的重击
examples.expression_mechanism: 时间未到一半 vs 收入过半归属他人的双重对比
examples.example_text: You're not even halfway through the fall yet, and more than half of what you've earned this season already legally belongs to someone else
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用两个"一半"的错位对比放大单笔扣减的冲击力
examples.negative_instruction: 不得夸张比例;对比的两个口径必须同口径可核实

examples.psychological_goal: 用单句硬切宣告新扣减项登场,维持扣减链节奏
examples.expression_mechanism: 无寒暄的短句转场,直接点名下一项
examples.example_text: And there is also a mill.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句最短宣告切换扣减项,清单式结构靠转场续命
examples.negative_instruction: 不要加解释性前缀;转场句之后必须立刻给机制细节

examples.psychological_goal: 用压秤口碑的冷幽默把垄断地位具象化
examples.expression_mechanism: 小动作细节 + "没人会去争"的合理推论
examples.example_text: the thumb is lightly pressed against the scales, and no one in their right mind argues too hard
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一个微小的舞弊动作细节呈现垄断方的隐性权力
examples.negative_instruction: 不得把传闻当定论;口碑类细节需在新材料中有出处

examples.psychological_goal: 回报运行余额并与史书口径形成讽刺对照,完成现金线核心兑现
examples.expression_mechanism: 剩余数字 + "史书会自信地记载另一个数"的双数字对照
examples.example_text: This is what remains as cash from a season when the history books will confidently report that you earned seven shillings and sixpence.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在同一句话里并置实留数与权威口径数,让落差自己说话
examples.negative_instruction: 不得复制两个具体数字;对照必须同口径

examples.psychological_goal: 明示兑现开场登记的延迟数字,完成契约闭合
examples.expression_mechanism: "这就是开头那个数字"的callback宣告 + 量级重述
examples.example_text: This is the number from the beginning of this story. More than a quarter of your entire year
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在兑现点明示callback,让观众意识到环环扣合
examples.negative_instruction: 不要只兑现不点名;callback必须能被观众辨认

examples.psychological_goal: 去反派化:把愤怒升级为对累积系统的认知
examples.expression_mechanism: 先否掉"单一反派"预期,再给出"世代叠加的合法索取"替代解释
examples.example_text: This wasn't a system with one greedy villain secretly taking money from the top. It was a system deliberately built over generations
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"不是 X,而是 Y"的句式完成框架级重构
examples.negative_instruction: 不得替新材料强行去反派化;若真有单一责任方,此机制不适用

examples.psychological_goal: 用逐行替换让观众在自己的现代收入单上认出同一结构
examples.expression_mechanism: "现代名目 instead of 历史名目"的排比替换
examples.example_text: Income tax instead of tithe. Mandatory pension contribution instead of a charitable working day
examples.usage_instruction: 学习一行一换的古今映射,每行只替换一个名目
examples.negative_instruction: 不得跨口径硬凑映射;每行替换必须功能等价

examples.psychological_goal: 用学界重建的脆弱性结论给全片判断权威背书
examples.expression_mechanism: 三个最小意外排比推出全年负债的结论
examples.example_text: one bad harvest, one sick ox, or one extremely harsh court hearing could turn the entire year into debt rather than surplus
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用三个小而具体的意外排比,证明系统的脆弱性结论
examples.negative_instruction: 不得虚构学界结论;排比的意外必须都是材料中的真实风险

examples.psychological_goal: 把最终零头折算成购买力清单,让抽象剩余变成可感的寒酸
examples.expression_mechanism: 剩余金额 + 三件小物的购买力清单
examples.example_text: 17 and a half pence will buy you some salt, a repaired blade for next year's sickle, maybe a piece of rope
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把抽象余额换算成极短的购物清单,完成情绪落地
examples.negative_instruction: 不得复制清单内容;购买力换算需符合新材料的物价

examples.psychological_goal: 回收开场双堆意象,用"从未是同一堆"给主承诺盖章
examples.expression_mechanism: 开场意象首尾呼应 + 拟人化否定句
examples.example_text: The big pile from the beginning of history and the small pile that lies before you now were never really the same.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在结尾用开场意象的再解释完成首尾闭环
examples.negative_instruction: 不得只重复意象不再解释;回收必须带新判断

examples.psychological_goal: 主承诺闭合后用续集情境与上限悬念保持系列开放
examples.expression_mechanism: 下集情境预告 + 法定上限悬念问句
examples.example_text: Next time we'll follow what happens next year when a bad spring and poor harvest
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在主承诺闭合之后才开启续集环,不透支本片悬念
examples.negative_instruction: 不得用续集环替代本片主承诺的兑现
